description: Laying clay brick and concrete block masonry, mixing cement-sand mortars, plumbing walls, plastering surfaces, screeding floors, and installing ceramic tiles on civil building sites.
daily_tasks: Proportioning and mixing cement-sand mortar ratios (1:4 and 1:6)
Laying staggered brick courses in cement mortar with mason trowel (karni)
Checking wall verticality with heavy brass plumb bob (sahul)
Aligning horizontal course level with nylon stringline (sutra)
Transferring datum levels across rooms using clear water tube
Applying wall plaster coats and screeding flush with aluminum straight edge (fanti)
Smoothing plaster surfaces with wooden floats (gurmala)
advanced_tasks: Executing mirror-smooth water-resistant pure cement float finishing (ghoontai)
Constructing brick corbels, arches, and circular well masonry structures
Laying large-format vitrified floor tiles with level spacers and rubber mallets
Applying crystalline cementitious waterproofing slurry on sunken toilet slabs
materials: Burnt red clay bricks / AAC lightweight blocks
Tile adhesive mortar and epoxy grout
work_processes: Substrate Wetting -> Mortar Batching -> Corner Lead Masonry -> String Line Laying -> Plumb Checking -> Plaster Screeding -> Tile Fixing -> Water Curing
troubleshooting_tasks: Correcting wall out-of-plumb lean before mortar sets
Eliminating hollow drumming sounds under newly laid floor tiles
Preventing crazing cracks in curing plaster by regulating sand silt content
Ensuring bathroom floor slope directs water strictly toward floor drain traps
quality_inspection: Verifying consistent 10-12mm bed mortar joint thickness between brick courses
Confirming zero deviation against plumb bob line over 10-foot wall height
Checking absence of hollow voids under bedded masonry units
Testing 7-14 day water curing dampness on plaster and masonry
measurement_and_planning: Calculating brick count and cement bag requirements from wall area (approx 500 bricks per 100 cu ft)
Establishing finished floor level datum (FFL) across building rooms
safety_practices: Inspecting wooden or bamboo scaffolding knots and platform planks before elevation work
Wearing heavy rubber gloves when handling alkaline wet Portland cement
Using correct ergonomic lifting posture when hoisting heavy mortar pans
Wearing sturdy protective footwear on construction debris sites
maintenance: Washing cement encrustations off trowels and aluminum screeds daily
Checking water level tube for trapped air bubbles or kink deformities
Protecting plumb bob brass tip from blunt drop damage
customer_communication: Advising building owners on cement mortar ratios and sand washing necessity
Estimating material delivery schedules to avoid work stoppages
Explaining the vital structural importance of minimum 10-day water curing

official_vocational_references.ssc: Construction Skill Development Council of India

canonical_skills: Ceramic Floor and Wall Tile Screeding
